name: Silas's Cenotaph
reqs: 100r HVY, 50r INT OR 50r WLL OR 50r CHA
desc: The very tombstone of Silas Ardenstar, fashioned into a gnarly greatsword by the Spellhardt family, as a sick joke after his initial demise. His mummified, shrunken head, armed with a petrifying gaze, is now also at your disposal. The visage of the Ardenstar patriach strikes fear into the hearts of many, even in death.
